title: Turn of the month on NIFTY and BANKNIFTY futures
hypothesis: Index futures held from the close one or two sessions before month end to two to four sessions into the new month earn a higher mean daily return than on other sessions, and a positive return after charges.

mechanism.text: Salary and SIP inflows early in the month, fund flows and window dressing at month end.

evidence.finding: Returns concentrated in the first half of the month and its turn.

evidence.source: McConnell and Xu, Financial Analysts Journal 64(2)
Review of Finance and Banking 15 (citing Karmakar and Chakraborty 2003; Archana, Safeer and Kevin 2014)
evidence.finding: Mixed: found in some samples, not significant in others.

universe.name: nifty-banknifty-futures
universe.rule: Near-month futures (next month when the near one expires inside the window); notional equal to capital.

turnover.basis: 12 round trips x 0.080% futures round trip, on notional

prior_trials.basis: No calendar rule has been run in this repo.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout net return after charges above zero and the in-window mean daily return above the other sessions' mean.

kill_criteria: Holdout net at or below zero after charges.
In-window mean daily return not above the other sessions' mean (a two-sample bootstrap p above 0.10).
Benjamini-Hochberg across the programme at q = 0.10 does not keep it.

prior.reason: Cheap, few knobs, plausible flows; Indian evidence mixed and the effect small next to index noise.

feasibility.reason: Index closes alone can test it now; futures from #71 for the final run.

contamination: trader-regime and the lab's regime split read NIFTY 50 closes for 2024 to 2026; no calendar or trend rule on index futures has been run in this repo. The holdout overlaps those sessions.
